reasons_add: Al-Jishumi draws the practical conclusion that one must turn to God alone in every circumstance, since benefit and harm ultimately come from Him.
Al-Qashani explains the distance of the error through attachment to the invoked object, which veils the caller from the Real.
Al-Qashani locates the nearer harm in the caller's own invocation and attachment: stopping with the object veils the caller from the Real.
Al-Qashani adds that calling on or stopping with something besides God veils one from the Real; this is why such attachment is distant error and its harm is nearer than its benefit.
